# Kolosei

> Kolosei is a founder-led studio building AI-powered Hebrew language tools, with LinguistPro as its flagship. Built on Google Cloud (Gemini, Cloud Text-to-Speech, Cloud Translation v3). A second research vertical covers parent-driven rare-disease genomics.

Founder: Peter Kolosei <peter@kolosei.com>
GitHub: https://github.com/SindromRadioSpb
OSF: https://osf.io/zdv9j (LinguistPro preregistration)
Last updated: 2026-07-30

## Products

### LinguistPro — flagship (https://linguistpro.kolosei.com)

- Repo: https://github.com/SindromRadioSpb/tts-prototype-android (public)
- Local-first Hebrew learning workspace. PWA with OPFS + SQLite WASM for the primary workspace; account sync, research, Telegram/Mini App and connected-agent access are separate opt-in capabilities.
- Studio import: pasted text, public articles, PDF/DOCX, JPEG/PNG/WebP, uploaded audio/video up to 3 hours / 300 MB, VTT/SRT and user-provided YouTube transcripts/captions.
- Studio output: line-by-line Hebrew tables, niqqud, translation, audio, segment-aware karaoke, progressive long-media processing and separate A1-B2 graded retellings.
- Deterministic learning core: honest morphology with provenance and ambiguity, shipped offline Pealim inflection data, FSRS-6 contextual review, canonical personal notes across Studio/Reading Room and production-grade Anki export/read-back.
- Google Cloud in production: Gemini API (tables, OCR, ASR and graded retelling), Cloud Text-to-Speech and Cloud Translation v3. BYOK credentials stay in the browser; the selected source is processed under the user's provider account.
- v3.11 series in production on Hetzner + Coolify.
- Reading Room (https://linguistpro.kolosei.com/library.html): 26,455 public-domain works from Project Ben-Yehuda catalogued by period and author; 796 prepared for interactive reading with translation, Dicta niqqud, search, morphology, provenance, contextual FSRS review and on-device i+1 recommendations. The rest are explicitly marked as awaiting processing.
- Experimental integrations: consent-controlled Telegram learning and OAuth/MCP connections to external AI assistants have passed owner-live testing but remain an owner pilot, not generally available or externally validated.
- Research: preregistered ulpan-cohort study at OSF zdv9j; planned testing with 2 cohorts x 20 students.

### HDLE Premium — V_book (https://github.com/SindromRadioSpb/v_book)

- Desktop Hebrew lexicography and terminology extraction (Python + PyQt6, SQLite FTS5, Stanza NLP).
- Google Cloud in production: Cloud Translation v3 (official client) with budget guards.
- AES-256-GCM credential encryption; portable .hdleproj project bundles. v1.0.1.

### EgorGenom — research vertical

- Parent-driven whole-genome sequencing analysis for a child with a suspected genetic disease. Built on nf-core/sarek and nf-core/raredisease (Nextflow, WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04).
- Repository is private out of clinical sensitivity (contains identifiable patient data). Not a commercial product.
- Planned Google Cloud usage: Vertex AI, BigQuery (gnomAD), Cloud Storage, Document AI.

## Working style and biases

- Thorough over quick. Prefers enriching complete analyses over subjective top-N shortcuts.
- Privacy-first: the primary workspace stays local; cloud processing, sync, research and integrations are separately disclosed and consent-controlled.
- Documentation updated in the same session as findings; reproducibility, versioning, changelogs.

## How to cite

For citations of LinguistPro or related research, please reference the OSF preregistration (osf.io/zdv9j) and contact research@kolosei.com.
